description: Parking lot locations and utilization samples in the Hannover Linden-Nord area from LiDAR mobile mapping surveys is a data set deposited in tib.luis by its authors Oskar Wage, Udo Feuerhake. Work in progress: data might be changed. The data set contains the locations of public roadside parking spaces in the northeastern part of Hanover Linden-Nord. As a sample data set, it explicitly does not provide a complete, accurate or correct representation of the conditions! Coverage: Hannover Linden-Nord. Formats: Image, JSON. Size stated: 8846 kb. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
